name: Product Hunt
note: The one launch that still moves. Needs a real product + 12h of reply time.

name: Hacker News (Show HN)
note: Show HN: title must start 'Show HN:'. Best technical audience, harshest.

name: Indie Hackers
note: Post revenue numbers / post-mortems, not announcements. Nofollow.

name: BetaList
note: Pre-launch only. Submit while still in beta; free tier can queue for weeks.

name: Uneed
note: Daily hand-picked launches, DR ~60. Free slot, badge/paid for guaranteed dofollow.

name: Peerlist
note: Weekly project spotlight, DR 77. Launches Mon-Thu, needs a portfolio/profiles.

name: Microlaunch
note: Monthly leaderboard, kinder to tiny products than PH.

name: Fazier
note: Free launch board, dofollow on free tier.

name: OpenHunts
note: Product Hunt alternative, upvotes only.

name: PitchWall
note: AI/maker wall. Good for AI tools, fast approval.

name: BuildHop
note: Ranks by time-on-page, not votes. Refuses products whose site won't load in an iframe.

name: IndieHackerStacks
note: Lists what you built with. Free + dofollow for life, DR ~30.

name: Awesome Indie
note: 9k makers, but the queue is months long — submit early, forget it.

name: AlternativeTo
note: Traffic gold if you are 'an alternative to X'. Add yourself as an alternative to 3 incumbents.

name: SaaSHub
note: Free listing + a free 110-directory submission checklist once approved.

name: SourceForge
note: Only worth it for open-source / self-hostable products. DR 92.

name: SideProjectors
note: Showcase + buy/sell side projects. Some buyers come looking here.

name: ScrollLaunch
note: Weekly board, 25 free slots/week. Free backlink only while their badge is on your site.

name: TinyLaunch
note: Monday launches, ~4 week free queue. Dofollow only for top 3 + badge.

name: Smol Launch
note: First launch free, 50 shared slots/week, needs 3 votes on other launches.

name: MakerHunt
note: Weekly Monday 8am UTC hunt. Free = badge + nofollow; $29 = dofollow.

name: Sidehunt
note: Weekly indie hunt, 400-word floor, calendar booked months out.

name: IndieHunt
note: 15 free slots/week, badge required, top-3 free can earn dofollow.

name: Startup Fast
note: 5 free slots/day, up to 90 days wait. Dofollow only for daily top 3 + badge.

name: Firsto
note: Fair-launch board — every launch actually gets seen.

name: DailyPings
note: Instant listing, no queue. Badge re-checked daily — remove it and you're delisted.

name: ProductBurst
note: Monday batches, homepage for 30 days, no approval step.

name: TryLaunch
note: Free = standard queue; $39 Pro picks your date + newsletter.

name: LaunchIgniter
note: Small but real vote board, quick approval.

name: EarlyHunt
note: Weekly AI hunts for people who want to be early testers.

name: Launching Next
note: Old-school startup directory, free listing, steady trickle.

name: Startup Stash
note: Curated tool directory — historically paid to list, ask first.

name: Startup Buffer
note: Newsletter + directory for new products, free submission.

name: StartupBlink
note: Ecosystem map — also gets you listed as an Indian startup, useful locally.

name: ShowBuild
note: Hacker News for builders — small, friendly, good feedback.

name: BetterLaunch
note: Free posting, discovery-focused.

name: Huzzler
note: Free = ~72 day queue, no Google indexing. $29 = live today, DR 70+ dofollow.

name: BuildVoyage
note: Curated micro-SaaS directory.

name: Promote Project
note: Startup articles + listings, free submit.

name: Find Your SaaS
note: SaaS discovery list.

name: SaaSHunt
note: SaaS directory with voting.

name: Idea Kiln
note: 'Ship it forward' — feedback-first board.

name: FindAlternate
note: Alternatives directory built for Google + AI answers.

name: Alterm
note: Software alternatives directory — list as alternative to incumbents.

name: EuroAlternative
note: Only if you have an EU/UK company + EU hosting. Otherwise skip.

name: Extension Launch
note: Chrome/extension products only — perfect if you ship an extension.

name: Show Me Best AI
note: AI tool list, free submit.

name: Future Tools
note: Matt Wolfe's list — submission is paid, big AI audience.

name: Toolify
note: Largest AI tool directory. Free listing queue, paid for featured.

name: AI Valley
note: Newsletter + directory, free submit.

name: AI Tools Club
note: AI directory, reviews included.

name: Aura++
note: AI tool wall.

name: AI for Developers
note: Dev-tool focused AI list.

name: Dev Resources
note: 800+ dev resources, PR on GitHub or form submit.

name: Micro SaaS Examples
note: 500+ micro-SaaS ideas & examples — good for research too.

name: G2
note: Free profile, but competing in software categories. Needs real customers for reviews.

name: Capterra
note: Gartner-owned, free listing, strong B2B search traffic.

name: GetApp
note: Same family as Capterra — one submission usually covers both.

name: SoftwareSuggest
note: India-focused B2B software discovery — good for INR pricing.

name: Crozdesk
note: Business software discovery + lead gen.

name: TrustRadius
note: B2B reviews; slow but high-intent buyers.

name: Crunchbase
note: Company profile. Free tier is limited; useful for credibility, not traffic.

name: Reddit r/SideProject
note: Read the rules; feedback posts work better than promo posts.

name: Lobsters
note: Invite-only for submissions — needs a vouch. Technical audience.

name: StackShare
note: Tool profile + stack listings.
